answer: Honesty futures price identity one at $50, and each next one from the same backer climbs one terrace at $50 times its number. Every identity enters the river through one inlet tied to its backer, so clones cannot hide. Five auditors check fraud proofs each epoch. One proven fake collapses that terrace, every stake settles at zero and its identities lose weight for 10 epochs. One hundred clones from one backer total $252,500, against $5,000 for 100 honest agents. A scalper buying the whole row pays little for the first ticket, a fortune for the hundredth, and one fake ID voids the row.
